buyingJourney.heading: Your Guide to Buying Property in the UK
buyingJourney.subheading: From your first consultation to key handover, we'll guide you through every stage of buying property in the UK.

s1.title: Consultation & Investment Planning
s1.body: Understand your goals, budget, and lifestyle to build a tailored property strategy.

s2.title: Property Selection
s2.body: Explore carefully selected developments that match your requirements.

s3.title: Financing & Budget Confirmation
s3.body: Understand your budget, financing options, and total purchase costs before moving forward.

s4.title: Reservation & Securing Your Property
s4.body: Secure your chosen property through a straightforward reservation process.

s5.title: Legal Checks
s5.body: Complete legal checks and documentation with trusted solicitors.

s6.title: Exchange of Contracts
s6.body: Exchange contracts and make your purchase legally binding.

s7.title: Completion & Key Handover
s7.body: Complete your purchase and receive the keys to your new property.

about.heading: About Us
about.bodyParagraph1: MAK Global helps local and international buyers easily purchase property in London. We simplify the complex overseas buying process by providing accurate information, trusted partners, and carefully selected opportunities.
about.bodyParagraph2: Thanks to our strong background in construction, we don't just sell properties—we guide you through every single stage, including planning, development, delivery, and after-sales support. From our very first meeting until you get your keys, our goal is to help you make the right decisions and secure long-term investment value.

zoneIsometric.subheading: Your ultimate guide to the capital. Discover London's top attractions, elite student life, and the unique experience of everyday living in this global hub.

services.heading: A Service Tailored To Your Needs
services.body: Every buyer's needs are different. Whether you're planning a purchase for personal living, a second home, or investment purposes, our goal is to provide guidance suited to your objectives.

propertySourcing.title: Property Sourcing
propertySourcing.body: We help you identify projects that match your budget, goals, and preferred locations. The opportunities in our portfolio are carefully selected based on location, developer track record, and market dynamics.

investmentAdvisory.title: Investment Advisory
investmentAdvisory.body: By understanding our clients' investment objectives, we help them evaluate opportunities that can create long-term value.

reservationSupport.title: Reservation Process Support
reservationSupport.body: Once the right property has been identified, we provide the guidance needed during the reservation stage to help the process move forward smoothly.

developerLiaison.title: Developer Liaison
developerLiaison.body: Throughout the purchasing process, we support communication between the developer and the buyer, helping ensure necessary information and updates are shared in a timely manner.

solicitorIntroductions.title: Solicitor Introductions
solicitorIntroductions.body: We can connect our clients with independent, trusted solicitors experienced in working with international buyers.

propertyManagement.title: Property Management Referrals
propertyManagement.body: After the purchase, we can refer clients to trusted partners offering property management and rental services.

aboutUs.heading: Our Story
aboutUs.storyBody1: MAK Global was founded to provide trusted guidance to both local and international buyers looking to purchase property in London.
aboutUs.storyBody2: We understand that buying property overseas can be a complex process. That's why we make it clearer and more accessible for our clients — offering accurate information, trusted partners, and carefully selected opportunities.

industryKnowledge.title: Industry Knowledge Beyond Sales
industryKnowledge.body: Thanks to our experience in construction and real estate, we evaluate projects not only from a sales perspective, but also in terms of development, delivery, and long-term value potential.

carefulSelection.title: Carefully Selected Opportunities
carefulSelection.body: The projects in our portfolio are carefully selected based on location, developer track record, and market dynamics.

guidanceThroughout.title: Guidance Throughout The Journey
guidanceThroughout.body: From the first meeting to key handover, we guide our clients at every stage to help them make more informed decisions.

internationalExperience.title: International Buyer Experience
internationalExperience.body: We provide support with the legal processes, financing options, and purchasing procedures that international buyers may encounter.

trustedNetwork.title: Trusted Professional Network
trustedNetwork.body: We work with a trusted network of experienced solicitors, mortgage advisors, developers, and property management specialists.

longTermApproach.title: A Long-Term Approach
longTermApproach.body: Our goal is not just to complete a sale, but to build long-term, trust-based relationships with our clients.

discoverLondon.bodyLine1: We are collecting the best local stories, property insights, and neighborhood highlights to help you find not just a house, but a home.
discoverLondon.bodyLine2: Check back soon to explore London like a local!
